about_the_game:
CHOOSE YOUR CONTRACT

Every mission is a gamble—select from three randomized contracts before entering a new dimension. Each contract has a unique objective, from high-risk assassinations to dangerous extractions. Adapt, strategize, and survive against escalating threats. Succeed, and you’ll earn Darkmatter, a permanent currency that can be spent anywhere—during a mission or between runs—to unlock game-changing abilities, new classes, and cosmetics. But beware—the Contractor isn’t always on your side. Hidden risks lurk within each deal, and betrayal may come when you least expect it.

DEAL WITH SHADY TRADERS

Across dimensions, mysterious traders offer powerful gear—if you can afford their price. Weapon upgrades, gadgets, and rare artifacts can shift the odds in your favor, but some deals come with unseen consequences. Every item holds a piece of the world’s history, and hidden within their descriptions are cryptic clues about Mr. B, the enigmatic Contractor who controls your fate. Who is he? Why does he know so much? And more importantly—can he be trusted?

EVOLVE YOUR PLAYSTYLE

Choose from four unique characters, each with their own playstyle, strengths, and special abilities. Every dimension is different—face rogue AI warlords, space pirates, loot goblins, and other unpredictable threats. Side quests and hidden objectives reward risk-takers with rare loot and deeper secrets. With every contract, the universe reshapes itself, ensuring no two missions are ever the same.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH A CREW

Take on contracts alone or with up to 10 players in chaotic co-op action. Team up, combine abilities, and adapt to the ever-changing threats of each dimension. Choose from four distinct characters: Jack, the Scarecrow Bandit, a trickster with deadly precision; Roxan, the Time-Warped Mercenary, wielding futuristic tech; Roth, the Demigod, a force of raw destruction; and Bob, the Military Mechanic, a master of gadgets and heavy firepower.
